_note: Manual draft-eligibility + age overrides the model can't infer. 'ineligible': players who cannot enter the draft (already been a pro / used their eligibility). 'age': real age (years) for players whose class year is unknown or misleading — feeds the draft-age penalty (NBA values youth). Keyed by exact player name. 'eligible_from': first NBA Draft a player can enter (reclassified high-schoolers too young for the next draft) — he is left off earlier boards and appears on that year's board.
